outcome: brain echogenicity in seven brain regions (frontal, parietal, occipital, and perirolandic white matter, caudate nucleus head, lentiform nucleus, and thalamus)
intra-observer reliability of brain echogenicity measurements
cohort: 20 term neonates with HIE and 20 term healthy neonates
finding: Quantitative neurosonography using brain echogenicity ratios showed significantly higher values in all seven brain regions of neonates with HIE compared to healthy controls, with the perirolandic white matter showing the greatest difference and highest diagnostic accuracy.
